properties.name: ydsz.web.security.enabled
properties.description: Enable Spring Security integration (401/403 JSON response handlers).

properties.name: ydsz.web.session.enabled
properties.description: Enable Redis distributed session sharing. Requires spring-session-data-redis dependency.

properties.name: ydsz.web.cors.enabled
properties.description: Enable CORS cross-origin support.

properties.name: ydsz.web.cors.allow-credentials
properties.description: Allow sending cookies and credentials. When true, allowedOriginPatterns cannot contain "*".

properties.name: ydsz.web.cors.allowed-origin-patterns
properties.description: List of allowed origin patterns. Supports wildcards like "https://*.example.com".

properties.name: ydsz.web.cors.allowed-headers
properties.description: List of allowed HTTP request headers. Default is ["*"].

properties.name: ydsz.web.cors.allowed-methods
properties.description: List of allowed HTTP methods. Default is ["*"].

properties.name: ydsz.web.cors.exposed-headers
properties.description: List of response headers exposed to the client. Default is empty.

properties.name: ydsz.web.cors.max-age
properties.description: Pre-flight request cache duration in seconds.

properties.name: ydsz.web.cors.path-pattern
properties.description: URL path pattern for CORS configuration.

properties.name: ydsz.web.cors.order
properties.description: Filter registration order. Lower value = higher priority.

properties.name: ydsz.web.trace.enabled
properties.description: Enable request tracing and TraceId response header.

properties.name: ydsz.web.trace.response-header-enabled
properties.description: Output trace/request ID in response header.

properties.name: ydsz.web.trace.request-log-enabled
properties.description: Enable request/response logging.

properties.name: ydsz.web.trace.log-level
properties.description: Request log level. Supports "INFO" or "DEBUG".

properties.name: ydsz.web.trace.sampling-rate
properties.description: Request log sampling rate, range [0, 1]. 1.0 = full logging.

properties.name: ydsz.web.trace.log-request-body
properties.description: Log full request body. May impact performance and leak sensitive data.

properties.name: ydsz.web.trace.log-response-body
properties.description: Log full response body. May produce large logs.

properties.name: ydsz.web.content-cache.max-size
properties.description: Max request body cache size in bytes for ContentCachingFilter. Default 2MB.

properties.name: ydsz.web.user-agent.enabled
properties.description: Enable User-Agent analyzer bean. Disable to save memory on non-web services.

properties.name: ydsz.web.health-indicator.enabled
properties.description: Enable Web health indicator for Actuator health check.

properties.name: ydsz.web.multipart.enabled
properties.description: Enable unified multipart config (overrides Spring Boot default 1MB/10MB).

properties.name: ydsz.web.multipart.max-file-size
properties.description: Max size per uploaded file. Default 50MB (overrides Spring Boot default 1MB).

properties.name: ydsz.web.multipart.max-request-size
properties.description: Max total size of a multipart request. Default 100MB.

properties.name: ydsz.web.multipart.file-size-threshold
properties.description: File size threshold for writing to disk. Default 0 (in-memory).

properties.name: ydsz.web.multipart.resolve-lazily
properties.description: Whether to resolve multipart lazily at access time.

properties.name: ydsz.web.multipart.location
properties.description: Temp directory for uploaded files. Empty = Servlet container default.

properties.name: ydsz.web.shutdown.log-enabled
properties.description: Enable graceful shutdown observability logging (ContextClosedEvent / WebServerInitializedEvent).
